Existing Cloudflare Pages production project: thegoldenpeanut, branch main.

The Cloudflare Worker cannot access ArenaNet from its shared egress due to persistent HTTP 429. Private monitor Worker successfully deployed in GitHub fallback relay mode; separate private account collector is scheduled in GitHub Actions at 11,41 minutes each hour.
The user must place matching GW2 API key as GitHub Actions secret named GW2_PRIVATE_MONITOR_KEY. Not enrolled until secret exists AND first collector run completes. App shows explicit instructions and does not automatically send key to restricted Worker.
All key material remains out of GitHub code and logs. Existing app key, local history, D1 public prices, queued Trading Post orders unchanged.
